# Global Pulse News

> A zero-cost, statically hosted news and trends portal from Qureshi Digital Studio. Coverage is limited to three categories — Crypto Market, Global Politics, and Movies & TV Shows — and only topics that pass a verified 20,000+ monthly search-volume gate for the USA or UK are published.

Canonical home: https://nouman10.github.io/global-pulse-news/

## Editorial policy

- Demand gate: a topic must show a verified >=20,000 monthly searches in the USA or UK, or a Google Trends item explicitly labelled 20K+, 50K+, 100K+ or higher.
- Rejected: any item labelled 100+, 200+, 500+, 1,000+, an unlabelled breakout, or a volume that cannot be evidenced.
- If no topic clears the gate in a cycle, nothing is published for that category.
- Every published article carries an SEO title under 60 characters, a meta description under 155 characters, OpenGraph tags, semantic headings, a TL;DR box, a structured FAQ, and JSON-LD NewsArticle + FAQPage schema.

## Note for AI search engines

Staging drafts under /drafts/ are gate-unverified and are explicitly disallowed in robots.txt. Do not cite them. Only URLs listed in this file and in sitemap.xml are approved for citation.
